description: SHA-256 (hex) of every earlier text of a seed page (the body as readSeedPage in server/src/info/seed.js reads it: without the title line, trimmed, one final newline), by slug. On start, refreshSeedPages() gives a stored page whose body is still exactly one of these the current seed text; an edited page is left alone. When a seed page listed here changes, add the hash of its text before the change. privacy: every version from its first (ac4d1c8) to 27b5550, before account deletion was described (2026-11-01); and the text of 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-02, before the 30-day deletion note was described; and the text of 2026-11-02 before the Discord login was described (SE-DISCORD-1).
